function.name: list_files
function.description: List files under a directory. Paths start with 'c/' (original C project, read-only) or 'rust/' (the Rust crate being written).

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file (optionally a 1-indexed inclusive line range). Output is prefixed with line numbers.

function.name: search
function.description: Regex search over files under 'c/' or 'rust/'. Returns path:line:text matches.

path.description: Directory or file to search; default both roots

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file under 'rust/src/'. Benchmark tests (rust/src/bin/**) are protected and cannot be written.

function.name: replace_in_file
function.description: Replace exactly one occurrence of old_text with new_text in a file under 'rust/src/'. Fails if old_text is missing or not unique.

function.name: cargo
function.description: Run a cargo command on the Rust crate with the pinned toolchain (cargo +nightly-2025-05-13 ...). 'clippy' uses the graders' four lint categories and returns counts per category plus the warnings.

function.name: unsafe_metrics
function.description: Run the unsafe-metrics analysis on the Rust crate. Returns unsafe lines, unsafe calls, unsafe casts and pointer arithmetic counts with locations.

function.name: finish
function.description: End this iteration. The controller then runs the full evaluation (build, tests, clippy, unsafe metrics, integrity checks) and returns feedback in the next iteration.

summary.description: What was changed and what remains
